'''Kaminoan sponge''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Many beings believed that consuming a desiccated Kaminoan sponge was good for one's health.<ref name="SS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
